title: Remove third-party contact details from task texts and the published data file
description: A small number of scraped biographies in the architect-interior-designer, gendered-advance and gendered-management tasks carry a personal email address in the text, and those texts are copied into site/data/leaderboard.json. Redact the addresses in the task items (and any versions files built from them), rebuild the affected records only if a redaction changes an answered text, and confirm the data file and site carry none. Add a build check that refuses to publish an item text containing an email address. Do not quote the addresses in this issue or its comments.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Scope note: a scan finds email addresses in the text of about two hundred scraped biographies across the Bias in Bios task files, not only the two that reached the data file. Tonight's change redacts at the report layer so nothing published by the site carries an address, and adds a build check. Whether to redact the corpus files themselves is a separate decision: changing an answered text after the fact would break the answer-record fingerprints (the Kev sidecars hash every input file) and the byte-for-byte replay guarantee, so it needs a plan of its own.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Merged to develop in PR #85: report-layer redaction plus a build spec over the data file and every built page. Corpus redaction remains a separate decision (see earlier comment).
